core_question: How do you fix a tent that's leaking in the rain? (secondary: How do you keep a cake from sticking to the pan when baking?)
answer_summary: Clean and dry the tent, apply seam sealer along the stitched seams where leaks usually start, and spray the rainfly and floor with a durable water repellent (DWR) waterproofing spray, letting everything cure fully before the next use.; after the topic shift: Coat the inside of the pan with butter or shortening, dust with flour and tap out the excess (or line the bottom with a parchment paper round), so the baked cake releases cleanly after cooling briefly.
